about_the_game:
Welcome to Quest Industries, franchisee! You've been "promoted" to middle-manager of this patch of chaotic reality, with nothing but a management cursor and a workforce of utterly unreliable Goblins. This isn't just an automation game; it's a disaster-management simulator.

A Garden of Emergent Chaos

Quest Industries is a systemic "toy box" first and a factory game second. Every item, building, and creature has Tags that constantly interact. Your Goblins can catch fire from a furnace, run into a water pool, and create a puff of Steam. Your goal isn't to prevent chaos; it's to harness it.

Automate with Agents, Not Belts

Forget conveyor belts. Your logistics network is alive, unreliable, and prone to panic. You dispatch Goblins to haul, build, and craft based on your factory's needs.

  • Set up Warehouses and Stockpile Zones to create production chains.

  • "Optimize" your Goblins by feeding them Junk Food (like explosive Pizzas or flammable Fries) for powerful buffs... and hilarious side effects.

  • Upgrade from chaotic Goblins to efficient, power-hungry Drones in the late game.

Explore a Gonzo Sci-Fi World

Unlock a grid of bizarre, hand-crafted biomes. Each new block is a resource-rich opportunity and a new set of systemic problems.

  • Build in a Volcano to use ambient Heat to speed up your Furnaces.

  • Brave the Fungal Swamp, whose Corrosive fog will rust any Ferrous metal left out.

  • Harvest ice from the Snowlands, but don't let your Goblins get Frozen solid.

Your ultimate goal? Meet the absurd quotas of the Quest Industries megacorp, build the Interdimensional Buyout Portal, and finally buy your freedom.

Key Features

Systemic Tag Engine: A physics-lite system where tags interact to create unpredictable, emergent gameplay.

  • Agent-Based Logistics: Manage a workforce of Goblins. Feed them, house them, and pray they don't walk through a fire while carrying a Bomb.

  • Deep Automation Chains: Build a sprawling industrial base, from basic Furnaces to magical Alchemist Labs and Junk-o-Tron kitchens.

  • Gated Exploration: Unlock 49 unique biome blocks, each with its own resources, systemic quirks, and environmental puzzles.

  • Satirical Sci-Fi Narrative: Discover the dark-humor-filled story of Quest Industries and build your way to corporate freedom.

short_description: Manage a chaotic goblin workforce in a science-fantasy world. Build a factory where your workers are flammable, your slimes are explosive, and your only goal is profit. Automate, survive the emergent chaos, and buy your freedom.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese
